title: euploca lagoensis
intro: Euploca lagoensis, commonly known as the "Lagoensis Euploca", is a plant species belonging to the family Boraginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities.
